quote: Malawi is struggling with a cholera outbreak that started in September 2004 and has so far affected 869 people, of which 9 died (case fatality of 1%). The last three weeks have seen a marked increase in the number of cases, going from tens to hundreds. During the week of 21 to 27 February alone, 9 districts reported 127 cases and 1 death.

quote: En 2012, l’épidémie a commencé à Gorom-Gorom en août et s’est propagée en septembre à Dori. Au total, 143 cas suspects de choléra et 7 décès (taux de létalité ≈ 4,9%) ont été notifiés entre août et novembre (Fig. 2). Pour la première fois depuis 2000, des épidémies ont été enregistrées deux années consécutives au Burkina Faso.
notes: 2012 epidemic total (Gorom-Gorom then Dori, Sahel region), the only 2012 cholera event in the factsheet. 'entre août et novembre' (2012): month-only start set to 1 August, end month read to 30 November. Suspected cases.

quote: CAR: Between July 5th and Aug 19th, 161 cholera cases incl. 19 deaths (CFR 11.8%) were notified.
notes: English highlights, paragraph 'CAR:'. Year 2016 from the document and the French text ('Du 05 juillet au 19 août 2016'). Stated interval 5 Jul-19 Aug 2016.

quote: CAR: Between July 5th and Aug 19th, 161 cholera cases incl. 19 deaths (CFR 11.8%) were notified. On Aug. 17th, 26 new cases were reported by MSF following a field investigation in Kembé village, sous-préfecture of Bimbo.
notes: '26 new cases were reported by MSF' on 17 Aug 2016 after a field investigation in Kembé village, Bimbo sub-prefecture: report-date count, sub-national. Quote includes the preceding sentence for the country name.

quote: Mais la déclaration officielle de l’épidémie par le niveau central n’est intervenue que le 29 Août 2016 après l’explosion d’un autre foyer à Gobada dans la commune de Savalou. Au moment de cette déclaration le Benin enregistrait déjà 129 cas et 6 décès.
notes: Second 2016 flare-up: start stated as 09 Aug 2016 ('La seconde flambée a débuté à partir du 09 août 2016'); counts as of the official declaration on 29 Aug 2016.

quote: En 2014, à la semaine 48, le Togo recensait 281 cas suspects5 répartis en 2 épisodes distincts, le premier en début d’année sur Lacs et le second à partir de juillet sur Lomé et les autres zones du pays.
notes: 2014 suspected cases as of epi week 48; TR is the end of ISO week 48 2014 (Sunday 30 Nov 2014). Two episodes (Lacs early in the year; Lomé and elsewhere from July). '5' after 'suspects' is a footnote marker.

quote: Cholera is an endemic disease in Guinea Bissau, besides epidemics are reported periodically in the country. Since 1986 the country has faced various cholera epidemics, being the most important in 1994 (15.719 cases, 290 deaths), 1996-97 (26.951 cases, 961 deaths) and 2005 (25272 cases and 399 deaths).
notes: Epidemic total labelled '1994' ('15.719' printed with a dot thousands separator). The document writes multi-year epidemics as ranges (1996-97, 2008-2009), so this is read as calendar 1994.
